name: nls.lm.control
title: Control various aspects of the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm

origin.description: Set the termination tolerances, the parameter scales, and the iteration limits used by nls.lm.
origin.usage: nls.lm.control(ftol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), ptol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), gtol = 0, diag = list(), epsfcn = 0, factor = 100, maxfev = integer(), maxiter = 50, nprint = 0)

arguments.name: ftol
arguments.text: Non-negative numeric. Stop when both the actual and predicted relative reductions in the sum of squares are at most ftol.

arguments.name: ptol
arguments.text: Non-negative numeric. Stop when the relative error between two consecutive iterates is at most ptol.

arguments.name: gtol
arguments.text: Non-negative numeric. Stop when the cosine of the angle between the residual and any Jacobian column is at most gtol in absolute value.

arguments.name: diag
arguments.text: Positive scale factors for the parameters, as a list or a numeric vector. The default is an empty list, which nls.lm replaces internally.

arguments.name: epsfcn
arguments.text: Relative error assumed in the functions when a forward-difference Jacobian is used. A value below machine precision uses machine precision.

arguments.name: factor
arguments.text: Positive numeric used to set the initial step bound. The usual value is 100.

arguments.name: maxfev
arguments.text: Function-evaluation limit. The default integer() has length zero. nls.lm replaces that empty value with 100 * (length(par) + 1).

arguments.name: maxiter
arguments.text: Positive integer. Stop when the number of iterations reaches maxiter.

arguments.name: nprint
arguments.text: Integer. A positive value prints the iterates.

origin.details: The function stores the nine arguments and does not fill maxfev. An empty maxfev is integer(0). An omitted diag is list().
origin.value: A list with ftol, ptol, gtol, diag, epsfcn, factor, maxfev, maxiter, and nprint.
